info.name: MCDSS - Phase 10A (Backend Gap-Fill)
info.description:
Verifies the Phase 10A backend work: the endpoints the Next.js screens need that did not exist after Phase 9, plus the director read-access and department-scoping changes.

Run against a live `docker compose up -d` stack with the seeded admin (admin@mcdss.local) and director (director@mcdss.local), both password `password`. The seeded director must lead at least one department, and at least one other department must have no director -- the setup folder asserts both and fails fast otherwise.

NEW ENDPOINTS COVERED
  GET    /api/dashboard/stats                         admin+director, scoped
  GET    /api/departments                             admin+director, scoped
  GET    /api/hiring-rounds                           admin+director
  GET    /api/hiring-rounds/{id}                      admin+director
  POST   /api/hiring-rounds                           admin
  PUT    /api/hiring-rounds/{id}                      admin
  GET    /api/applications                            admin+director, filters+pagination
  GET    /api/applications/{id}                       admin+director, full detail
  GET    /api/applications/{id}/documents             admin+director
  GET    /api/admin/applicants/export                 admin+director, streamed CSV
  GET    /api/assignment-runs                         admin+director
  GET    /api/admin/staff-accounts                    admin
  POST   /api/admin/staff-accounts/{user}/resend-invite  admin
  PATCH  /api/admin/staff-accounts/{user}/status      admin
  GET    /api/applicant/positions                     applicant
  GET    /api/applicant/positions/{id}                applicant
  GET    /api/applicant/applications                  applicant
  POST   /api/notifications/read-all                  any role
  GET    /api/documents/{id}/download                 any role, per-role checks

CHANGED (additive only -- earlier phase collections still pass)
  GET /api/positions and GET /api/positions/{id} moved from admin-only to admin+director
  GET /api/positions/{id}/criteria moved to admin+director
  GET /api/applications/{id}/status-history moved to admin+director
  GET /api/notifications gained a meta block with unread_count
  GET /api/assignment-runs/{id} gained deeper eager loads (no keys removed)
  GET /api/applicant/applications/{id} gained status_history (notes withheld)

ONE MANUAL STEP: 'Upload a Document' in folder 4 needs a PDF attached. Skip it and the download tests in folder 11 self-skip.
